name: Drop Prices for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Drop / Raise Price for WooCommerce (over time / countdown) is a plugin and excellent marketing tool which allows you to lower (or raise) price of a product over time in steps say $10 or 5% every hour. Finale Sales Countdown Discount Timer for WooCommerce alternative.

Support

You can contact us at our website wpgenie.org if you have problems or questions. Complete plugin documentation is here.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Drop / Raise Price for WooCommerce (over time) plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products > Add new product
  4. Add usual product info
  5. Under usual pricing info you will find new options for drop / raise price: Price change, Price change type, End price, Change price every n minutes, Change type, Counter?, Reset price and counter on order?, and Drop Price Timeframe
  6. Mandatory fields are Price change, Price change type, End price, Change price every n minutes, Change type

If you have any problems contact us at https://wpgenie.org/
sections.faq:
What is minimal time interval for drop / raise price?

Minimal interval is one minute.

Does this plugin support percentage drop / raise price?

Yes, it supports both fixed or percentage drop / raise price.

Can you reset drop / raise price after order?

Yes, it can be restarted by checking option “Reset price and counter on order”.

Can you set start and end time for drop / raise price?

Yes, it can be set using date picker labeled “Drop Price Timeframe”.

Have more questions?

Please send us your questions to info@wpgenie.org
